FOREIGN_COVERAGE.doc: Declaration coverage and implementation evidence stay separate.

members.name: state
members.spec: datatype state = Selected | Generated | Shimmed | Unselected | Unsupported of string
members.doc: Selection alone never claims generated or executable code.

members.name: entry
members.spec: type entry = {identity : ForeignModel.identity, source : ForeignModel.source, state : state}
members.doc: A foreign identity, original source and current delivery state.

members.name: Error
members.spec: exception Error of ForeignModel.source * string
members.doc: A source-located conflicting or stale coverage claim.

members.name: report
members.spec:
val report : {declarations : ForeignModel.declaration list,
  selected : ForeignModel.identity list, generated : ForeignModel.identity list,
  shimmed : ForeignModel.identity list, unsupported : (ForeignModel.identity * string) list} -> entry list
members.doc:
`report {declarations, selected, generated, shimmed, unsupported}`
produces one canonical entry per identity.

Implementation consumers supply generated/shimmed evidence only after producing those artifacts.

**Raises** `Error` for unknown identities or conflicting claims.

members.name: json
members.spec: val json : entry list -> Json.value
members.doc: `json entries` serializes the report without discarding source mappings.

FOREIGN_JSON.doc: JSON values with physical positions for declarative policy diagnostics.

members.name: document
members.spec: type document
members.doc: Validated JSON and the physical positions of values and object keys.

members.name: Error
members.spec: exception Error of ForeignModel.source * string
members.doc: A source-located syntax or schema error.

members.name: decode
members.spec: val decode : {file : string, text : string} -> document
members.doc:
`decode {file, text}` parses JSON and records physical positions.

**Raises** `Error` for malformed JSON.

members.name: value
members.spec: val value : document -> Json.value
members.doc: `value document` returns its parsed root.

members.name: location
members.spec: val location : document -> string list -> ForeignModel.source
members.doc: `location document path` finds a value by object keys/array indices.

members.name: error
members.spec: val error : document -> string list -> string -> 'a
members.doc: `error document path message` raises a source-located schema error.

members.name: object
members.spec: val object : document -> string list -> string list -> Json.value -> (string * Json.value) list
members.doc:
`object document path allowed value` validates keys and duplicates.

**Raises** `Error` for unknown/duplicate keys or a non-object value.

members.name: member
members.spec: val member : document -> string list -> (string * Json.value) list -> string -> Json.value
members.doc:
`member document path fields name` requires a named member.

**Raises** `Error` for a missing member.

members.name: optional
members.spec: val optional : (string * Json.value) list -> string -> Json.value option
members.doc: `optional fields name` looks up an optional member.

members.name: string
members.spec: val string : document -> string list -> Json.value -> string
members.doc: `string document path value` requires a JSON string.

members.name: boolean
members.spec: val boolean : document -> string list -> Json.value -> bool
members.doc: `boolean document path value` requires a JSON Boolean.

members.name: array
members.spec: val array : document -> string list -> Json.value -> Json.value list
members.doc: `array document path value` requires a JSON array.

FOREIGN_MODEL.doc: Foreign declarations, independent of target layout and SML projection.

members.name: source
members.spec: type source = {file : string, line : int, column : int}
members.doc: An original description's physical source position.

members.name: identity
members.spec: type identity = {family : string, namespace : string, name : string}
members.doc: A stable source identity, including the foreign namespace.

members.name: expression
members.spec: type expression = {family : string, text : string, source : source}
members.doc: An expression in its source language, before target evaluation.

members.name: foreignType
members.doc:
Foreign types. Backend-specific types stay explicit and cannot silently
become machine pointers or libffi scalars.

members.name: parameter
members.spec: datatype parameter = Parameter of {name : string option, ty : foreignType}
members.doc: A foreign parameter before naming, ownership or output projection.

members.name: field
members.spec:
datatype field = Field of {name : string option, ty : foreignType,
                      bits : expression option, source : source}
members.doc: A foreign aggregate member; bit widths remain source expressions.

members.name: declaration
members.spec:
type declaration = {identity : identity, ty : foreignType,
                    storage : string list, source : source}
members.doc: A declaration with source identity and linkage, separate from policy.

members.name: scalarLayout
members.spec: type scalarLayout = {size : int, alignment : int, signed : bool option}
members.doc: Target scalar facts, separate from SML host arithmetic.

members.name: byteOrder
members.spec: datatype byteOrder = Little | Big
members.doc: Target byte order.

members.name: target
members.spec:
type target = {name : string, abi : string, byteOrder : byteOrder,
               scalars : (string * scalarLayout) list}
members.doc: Target facts do not add ownership or projection to declarations.

members.name: layout
members.spec:
type layout = {size : IntInf.int, alignment : int,
               fields : (string * IntInf.int) list}
members.doc: A checked native layout produced by the layout consumer.

members.name: capabilities
members.doc: Backends state which source families and mechanisms they implement.

members.name: Error
members.spec: exception Error of source * string
members.doc: A source-located model diagnostic.

members.name: key
members.spec: val key : identity -> string
members.doc: `key identity` encodes a source identity without delimiter collisions.

members.name: fromC
members.spec: val fromC : CParse.declaration list -> declaration list
members.doc:
`fromC declarations` adapts parsed C declarations without applying
ownership, target widths or SML naming policy.

Unresolved redeclarations remain available for a selected consumer's
diagnostic; private declarations do not block unrelated selections.

members.name: fromCMacros
members.spec: val fromCMacros : CPreprocess.macro list -> declaration list
members.doc:
`fromCMacros macros` preserves macro source, parameters and body.
Macro identities occupy their own namespace; they are not functions.

members.name: canonical
members.spec: val canonical : declaration list -> declaration list
members.doc:
`canonical declarations` sorts identities and physical source positions.
Input traversal order cannot affect reports or selected closures.

members.name: reachable
members.spec: val reachable : declaration list * identity list -> declaration list
members.doc:
`reachable (declarations, selected)` resolves the transitive declaration
closure, including aliases, while retaining opaque aggregate pointers.

**Raises** `Error` for missing or ambiguous selected identities.

members.name: environment
members.spec: type environment
members.doc: An immutable lookup index over one declaration collection.

members.name: index
members.spec: val index : declaration list -> environment
members.doc:
`index declarations` prepares repeated identity lookups without
changing declaration/source information.

members.name: lookup
members.spec: val lookup : environment * identity -> declaration option
members.doc:
`lookup (environment, identity)` resolves one indexed identity.

**Raises** `Error` for an ambiguous identity.

members.name: find
members.spec: val find : declaration list * identity -> declaration option
members.doc:
`find (declarations, identity)` resolves an exact foreign identity.

**Raises** `Error` when that identity has incompatible redeclarations.

members.name: libffi
members.spec: val libffi : capabilities
members.doc:
`libffi` describes the dynamic C backend contract. Runtime availability
is checked separately; other families need explicit future backends.

FOREIGN_POLICY.doc: Declarative FFI policy; reading a sidecar never executes its adapters.

members.name: encoding
members.spec: datatype encoding = Bytes | Utf8 | Wtf8 | Utf16
members.doc: Supported text encodings; raw buffers use bytes explicitly.

members.name: direction
members.spec: datatype direction = In | Out | InOut
members.doc: Parameter movement and copy-back direction.

members.name: ownership
members.spec: datatype ownership = Borrowed of string | Owned of string
members.doc: Ownership is separate from C pointer syntax.

members.name: extent
members.spec: datatype extent = ParameterLength of string | FixedLength of IntInf.int
members.doc: Buffer extents name a parameter or a fixed element count.

members.name: smlType
members.spec:
datatype smlType = Scalar of string | Resource of string | Option of smlType
  | Vector of smlType | Array of smlType | Tuple of smlType list
  | Record of (string * smlType) list
members.doc: A structured SML type, never an executable SML source fragment.

members.name: tree
members.spec: datatype tree = Unit | Value of string | Product of tree list | Fields of (string * tree) list
members.doc:
Structured input/output grouping; leaves refer to foreign parameters
or `$result`. It contains no SML expressions.

members.name: valuePolicy
members.spec:
type valuePolicy = {name : string option, direction : direction option,
  ownership : ownership option, nullable : bool option, encoding : encoding option, terminator : bool option,
  extent : extent option, callback : string option, projection : smlType option,
  output : string option, consumes : bool, source : ForeignModel.source}
members.doc:
A parameter or returned-value annotation. Absence stays explicit until
declaration-aware validation; the decoder guesses no ownership.

members.name: errorPolicy
members.spec: type errorPolicy = {predicate : string, capture : string, getter : string option}
members.doc: Native error predicates and capture mechanisms are independent.

members.name: functionPolicy
members.spec:
type functionPolicy = {foreign : string, namespace : string, name : string, raw : string option,
  parameters : valuePolicy list, result : valuePolicy, errors : errorPolicy,
  variadic : string, unsafeRaw : bool, adapter : string option,
  input : tree option, returns : tree option,
  source : ForeignModel.source}
members.doc: A selected function and its naming/marshalling policy.

members.name: failure
members.doc:
A constant callback failure result, or a table keyed by one native
argument, such as a Win32 message identifier.

members.name: callbackPolicy
members.spec:
type callbackPolicy = {foreign : string, lifetime : string, owner : string option,
  thread : string, failure : failure, source : ForeignModel.source}
members.doc: Callback lifetime, thread and failure rules must be declared.

members.name: policy
members.doc: Sidecar contents; paths and library names are data.

members.name: Error
members.spec: exception Error of ForeignModel.source * string
members.doc: A source-located sidecar diagnostic.

members.name: decode
members.spec: val decode : {file : string, text : string} -> policy
members.doc:
`decode {file, text}` reads version one JSON policy, checking field
names, duplicates, names, enums and structured projection types.

**Raises** `Error` for malformed or unsupported policy.

members.name: rawName
members.spec: val rawName : string -> string
members.doc:
`rawName name` escapes foreign identifiers into legal SML value names.
A projection consumer must check collisions across its complete API.

FOREIGN_PROJECTION.doc: Structured public interfaces assembled from native values and outputs.

members.name: tree
members.spec: datatype tree = datatype ForeignPolicy.tree
members.doc:
A public argument/result tree. Leaves name foreign parameters;
`$result` names the native result. No leaf is executable source.

members.name: Error
members.spec: exception Error of ForeignModel.source * string
members.doc: A source-located projection error.

members.name: check
members.spec: val check : {source : ForeignModel.source, available : string list, projection : tree} -> unit
members.doc:
`check {source, available, projection}` verifies that every leaf has
a unique value binding and every record label is unique.

members.name: typeOf
members.spec:
val typeOf : {source : ForeignModel.source, values : (string * ForeignPolicy.smlType) list,
              projection : tree} -> ForeignPolicy.smlType
members.doc:
`typeOf {source, values, projection}` builds the SML type of a checked
projection from the separately established leaf types.

**Raises** `Error` for unknown leaves or duplicate fields.

members.name: callType
members.doc:
`callType {policy, inputs, result}` projects separately established
native value types into a public argument/result pair.

Annotations override leaf types; output parameters become returned values.

members.name: renderType
members.spec: val renderType : ForeignPolicy.smlType -> string
members.doc:
`renderType ty` emits a type using fixed scalar spellings and checked
resource names; it never copies arbitrary source text from policy.

FOREIGN_VALIDATE.doc: Declaration-aware checks before safe binding generation.

members.name: binding
members.spec: type binding = {declaration : ForeignModel.declaration, policy : ForeignPolicy.functionPolicy}
members.doc: A uniquely resolved function and its separate projection policy.

members.name: Error
members.spec: exception Error of ForeignModel.source * string
members.doc: A source-located ambiguity, contradiction or unsupported selection.

members.name: resolve
members.spec: val resolve : {declarations : ForeignModel.declaration list, policy : ForeignPolicy.policy} -> binding list
members.doc:
`resolve {declarations, policy}` resolves selected C functions and
validates names, pointer policy, extents, errors and callbacks.

**Raises** `Error` when selected declarations or annotations cannot
produce the requested safe interface without guessing.
